subject: Goal-met / reassess nudge after measurement save (+ refresh Weekly Review)
description: PROPOSED 2026-08-07 (Mark). When a body measurement is saved on the phone, compare the new values against the body-measurement goals on GoalSettings (weight/waist/body-fat/chest/shoulders/arms/thighs/calves) and, if a goal is MET or passed (direction inferred from prior vs target), surface a message right there prompting the user to reassess/adjust that goal (e.g. 'Weight goal 180 lb reached — set a new target?'). Also surface goal-met / reassess status in the WEEKLY REVIEW page (src/FitRecoveryLog/Components/Pages/WeeklyReview or weekly-review route) — Mark thinks that page is STALE, so first audit it (does it still render, is its data current post-refactor?) and refresh/fix as needed, then add the goals-progress/goal-met section. Depends on shoulders/calves being recordable measurements (in progress) so all goal metrics have a current value. Phone-first; consider mirroring the nudge on the web Measurements page. Reads GoalSettings (see [[fitlog-goals-architecture]]); no schema change expected. Relates to tasks 56/57/58.
note: Done 2026-08-07 (phone). Shared helper Services/GoalProgress.cs compares BodyMeasurement vs GoalSettings body goals (reduce-vs-gain direction inferred from a prior measurement; landing within 0.05 = met). (1) Measurements page: after Save, a highlighted 'Goal(s) reached!' card lists met goals with a 'Reassess goals' button → /goals, dismissable. (2) Weekly Review AUDIT: page was NOT stale — it reads current entities and works; added a Goals section (latest measurement vs each target, reached ✓ / X to go). Web mirror of the nudge deliberately NOT done (phone-first, optional). No schema change.
